page.content:
Arthur's father, who took Igraine at Tintagel by Merlin's art.

How Uther Pendragon connects

  • Character: King Arthur — Uther Pendragon is Arthur's father.
  • Location: Tintagel — Uther begot Arthur at Tintagel through Merlin's disguise.
  • Concept: Pendragon — Uther took the Pendragon name and standard.

What is Uther Pendragon?

Uther Pendragon is the war-leader whose desire for Igraine, enabled by Merlin, begets Arthur and leaves the boy to be hidden until the sword test.

Key threads lead to King Arthur, Tintagel and Pendragon.
